property_summary: For any actor and any amount am with 0 < am <= balances[actor], a successful CashOut(am) must leave balances[actor] == previous balance - am (an exact subtraction); the mutant sets the balance to 0, so whenever am is strictly less than the balance the invariant breaks.
change_summary: Replace the balance update with balances[msg.sender] = 0 so any successful cashout zeroes the caller's balance instead of subtracting exactly _am.
